findings.evidence: Issuer and subject are identical: 'CN=selfsigned.example.local'. Browsers and clients reject self-signed certificates as untrusted.
Certificate has no Subject Alternative Names (SAN) extension. RFC 2818 §3.1 requires SANs; CN-only matching was deprecated in Chrome 58 (2017).
RSA key is 1024 bits. The minimum recommended size is 2048 bits (NIST SP 800-131A, 2015).

summary: Analyzed 4 certificate(s). Found 4 issue(s): 2 HIGH, 2 MEDIUM.
